Technical Q&A format establishing a pattern of URL comparison examples, expecting continuation of the second URL's structure.

The question concerns query string parameter ordering, specifically whether a `?flag` parameter's position matters relative to other parameters like `foo=bar&flag=true&bar=baz`.

The final token `?flag` is the beginning of a second URL example (`https://example.com/?flag`), which is incomplete and expects continuation — likely `=true` or additional parameters, or a contrasting URL showing the flag alone or in a different position.
"First URL: `https://example.com/foo/bar/baz?flag=true&...`
Second URL: `https://example.com/?flag`" — the pattern suggests a parallel structure with a similar flag parameter or placeholder, likely referencing the same "flag" concept mentioned earlier.
